record.issue_text: handleNewBooking.ts (~line 1080): evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars) is a no-op when destinationCalendar is null, silently dropping team destination calendars; also users.slice(1) may still include the organizer in dynamic-group bookings producing duplicate entries and duplicate events on the same calendar

adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, evt.destinationCalendar is explicitly set to `... ? [..] : ... ? [..] : null`, so it can be null. The later `if (isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === "COLLECTIVE") { evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars); }` becomes a no-op when null, silently dropping collected team destination calendars (no fallback to initialize an array). Also, `teamMemberPromises = users.slice(1).map(...)` assumes the organizer is at `users[0]`, but for the dynamicUserList branch `prisma.user.findMany({ username: { in: dynamicUserList } })` does not guarantee ordering; thus the organizer may appear in `slice(1)`, causing their destinationCalendar to be added again and potentially leading to duplicate destinations and duplicate event creation (createAllCalendarEvents loops over destinationCalendar entries).
